# TypeScript SDK

The `holon-sh` package provides typed MCP clients and server-side HTML views for Node.js 22 or later.

| Import | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `holon-sh` | Generated `apps`, `createApps`, and project types |
| `holon-sh/runtime` | Low-level client construction and binding resolution |
| `holon-sh/view` | Server registration of built HTML views |
| `holon-sh/protocol` | Shared client/result types and `ToolCallError` |

The root exports named values: `import { apps, createApps } from "holon-sh"`.
The root re-exports your project's generated `Apps`, `Inputs`, `Outputs`, and
`Resources` from `.holon/generated/holon-sh/`, so install `holon-sh` in the
project's own `node_modules` and generate clients before importing it.

Run `holon types generate` from your project directory to use its `server.json`
dependencies, or pass explicit dependencies with
`holon types generate --server orders=https://orders.example.com/mcp`.
Then run `holon types check --no-generate` to check calls against the generated types.

Generated clients accept endpoint bindings. Hosts such as `holon-ui` can use the
low-level runtime's `CreateOptions.session` hook to serve custom bindings.
Use `appView` to register built HTML with a Node MCP server.

See [generate clients](https://holon-labs.dev/docs/#generate-clients),
[bind and authenticate clients](https://holon-labs.dev/docs/#bind-sdk-clients),
and [handle tool results](https://holon-labs.dev/docs/#handle-tool-results).

[Source](https://github.com/holon-sh/sdk-ts/blob/ec243a7a925a65e86be2d14b1a1df35082d7fcb4/packages/node/package.json)

# holon-sh/protocol

## Classes


### ToolCallError

Error thrown by the tools convenience methods for error or input_required results. A failure's message carries its text; `data` is what the server said in a form to branch on. Pass elicit to answer questions in place, or continue later through callTool.

#### Extends

- `Error`

#### Constructors


##### Constructor

> **new ToolCallError**(`app`, `tool`, `result`): [`ToolCallError`](#sdk/typescript/protocol/toolcallerror)

###### Parameters

###### app

`string`

###### tool

`string`

###### result

`InputRequiredResult` \| `Omit`\<`Fields`\<\{\[`key`: `string`\]: `unknown`; \}\>, `"structuredContent"` \| `"isError"`\> & `object`

###### Returns

[`ToolCallError`](#sdk/typescript/protocol/toolcallerror)

###### Overrides

`Error.constructor`

#### Properties


##### data?

> `readonly` `optional` **data?**: `unknown`

The failure's structured content, or else its text parsed as JSON when that text is JSON. Its shape is the server's own.


##### result

> `readonly` **result**: `InputRequiredResult` \| `Omit`\<`Fields`\<\{\[`key`: `string`\]: `unknown`; \}\>, `"structuredContent"` \| `"isError"`\> & `object`


##### text?

> `readonly` `optional` **text?**: `string`

The failure's text content, its text blocks joined by newlines. Undefined for questions left unanswered.

## Interfaces


### ToolClient

Client operations shared by generated app clients. Transport, validation, and protocol errors reject the returned promises.

#### Type Parameters

`O`

`R`

#### Properties


##### callTool

Return the full MCP result, preserving error results and questions left unanswered. Arguments and successful output are contract-validated.

##### close

> `readonly` **close**: () => `Promise`\<`void`\>

Close the cached endpoint session. Scoped calls close their own session; a host-owned session is closed by its host.

###### Returns

`Promise`\<`void`\>

> `readonly` **listTools**: (`options?`) => `Promise`\<\{\[`key`: `string`\]: `unknown`; \}\>

Fetch the live tool catalog.

###### Parameters

###### options?

[`CallOptions`](#sdk/typescript/protocol/calloptions)

###### Returns

`Promise`\<\{\[`key`: `string`\]: `unknown`; \}\>


##### resources

> `readonly` **resources**: \{ readonly \[U in string \| number \| symbol\]: \{ read: (options?: CallOptions) =\> Promise\<R\[U\]\>; watch: (onChange: (value: R\[U\]) =\> void \| Promise\<void\>, options?: \{ signal?: AbortSignal \}) =\> Promise\<void\> \} \}

Contracted JSON resources. read validates the first text content as JSON. watch requires an endpoint binding to a server that supports subscriptions; it reads the initial value, then listens for updates until aborted.


##### tools

> `readonly` **tools**: \{ readonly \[K in string \| number \| symbol\]: (input: I\[K\], options?: ToolCallOptions) =\> Promise\<K extends keyof O ? O\[K\] : CompleteResult\<unknown\>\> \}

Convenience methods returning structured output, or the complete MCP result, with its content blocks typed, for a tool without an output schema. Error results throw ToolCallError, as do questions left unanswered. Reserved object method names remain callable through callTool.

## Type Aliases


### AuthProvider

> **AuthProvider** = \{ `onUnauthorized?`(`context`): `Promise`\<`void`\>; `token`(): `Promise`\<`string` \| `undefined`\>; \} \| \{ `clientMetadata`: `unknown`; `redirectUrl`: `unknown`; `tokens`(): `unknown`; \}

Bearer-token or OAuth provider accepted by the MCP transport.

***


### CallMetadata

> **CallMetadata** = `Omit`\<`CallToolRequest`\[`"params"`\], `"name"` \| `"arguments"`\> & `object`

MCP request metadata and input continuation fields. Pass inputResponses and requestState when continuing an input-required result.

#### Type Declaration

### CallOptions

> **CallOptions** = `Omit`\<`RequestOptions`, `"allowInputRequired"`\>

MCP request options, including AbortSignal and timeout in milliseconds. A request without a timeout waits for its answer; progress from the server restarts a timeout. Input-required responses are enabled by the runtime.

***


### CompleteResult

> **CompleteResult**\<`Output`\> = `Omit`\<`Fields`\<`CallToolResult`\>, `"structuredContent"` \| `"isError"`\> & `object`

Call options for a tool. `elicit` answers its questions in place, so the call returns the completed result.

#### Type Declaration

> **ToolResult**\<`Output`\> = [`CompleteResult`](#sdk/typescript/protocol/completeresult)\<`Output`\> \| `Omit`\<`Fields`\<`CallToolResult`\>, `"structuredContent"` \| `"isError"`\> & `object` \| `InputRequiredResult`

Full tool result: successful typed output, an application error, or an input-required continuation.

`Output`

### bindApps()

> **bindApps**\<`B`\>(`identity`, `contracts`, `bindings`, `options?`): `Readonly`\<`Record`\<`string`, [`RuntimeClient`](#sdk/typescript/runtime/runtimeclient)\>\>

Construct only the explicitly bound dependencies. Unknown names throw; an empty binding map selects none. Used by generated createApps factories.

#### Type Parameters


##### B

`B` = [`Binding`](#sdk/typescript/runtime/binding)

### createApps()

> **createApps**\<`B`\>(`identity`, `contracts`, `bindings?`, `options?`): `Readonly`\<`Record`\<`string`, [`RuntimeClient`](#sdk/typescript/runtime/runtimeclient)\>\>

Construct runtime clients from identity and contracts. Connections open lazily. Explicit and resolved endpoint bindings reuse one session unless scoped is true; <NAME>_MCP_URL bindings use one session per call. Close persistent clients on shutdown. Most callers use the generated package root.

#### Type Parameters

#### Returns

`Readonly`\<`Record`\<`string`, [`RuntimeClient`](#sdk/typescript/runtime/runtimeclient)\>\>

### setDefaultBinding()

> **setDefaultBinding**(`resolve`): `void`

For hosts: register a process-wide resolver for clients created without explicit bindings. Explicit bindings take precedence; return undefined to fall back to the <NAME>_MCP_URL environment variable. Register during startup.

#### Parameters

# holon-sh/view

## Interfaces


### ViewOptions

Allowed network and asset domains for the view content security policy.

#### Properties


##### csp?

> `optional` **csp?**: `object`

###### connectDomains?

> `optional` **connectDomains?**: `string`[]

###### resourceDomains?

> `optional` **resourceDomains?**: `string`[]

## Variables


### VIEW\_MIME\_TYPE

> `const` **VIEW\_MIME\_TYPE**: `"text/html;profile=mcp-app"` = `"text/html;profile=mcp-app"`

MIME type of an MCP App HTML resource.

## Functions


### appView()

> **appView**(`name`, `uri`, `file`, `options?`): `ViewRegistration`

Create a registration tuple for server.registerResource(...appView(...)).
Node only: the HTML file is read once when this helper is called.
Resource reads reuse that promise; file read failures reject resource requests.

#### Parameters

##### name

`string`

Human-readable resource name.

##### uri

`string`

Resource URI, usually starting with ui://.

##### file

`string` \| `URL`

Built HTML file path or file URL.

##### options?

[`ViewOptions`](#sdk/typescript/view/viewoptions) = `{}`

View content security policy.

#### Returns

`ViewRegistration`

Name, URI, metadata, and resource-read callback.

#### Example

```ts
server.registerResource(...appView("App", "ui://app/index.html", new URL("./index.html", import.meta.url)));
```

[Source](https://github.com/holon-sh/sdk-ts/blob/ec243a7a925a65e86be2d14b1a1df35082d7fcb4/packages/node/src/view.ts)
